This is the standing agreement for approved access to restricted, deidentified BNR data. The agreement form appears immediately below; staff processing notes are available in the expandable box.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="BNR staff: process this agreement"}

### When to use it

Use the agreement when a researcher or research team requests restricted, deidentified record-level data. It is not normally required for aggregate products already approved and published through the Info-Hub.

### Procedure

1. Record the request and confirm its purpose, lead researcher and institution.
2. Check whether a public aggregate product can meet the need.
3. Agree the minimum dataset, disease area, period, format and version.
4. Confirm the legal, ethical, storage and access requirements.
5. Complete the agreement with the researcher and obtain the required BNR approval.
6. Store the signed agreement in the authorised internal location.
7. Record the approval and exact dataset released in the Data Release Register.
8. Release data only after every required decision and signature is complete.

### Records to retain

Retain the application, decision, agreement, dataset identity and version, approving role, transfer record, conditions, expiry or destruction requirement, and storage reference. Do not store completed agreements, personal details or correspondence in the public repository or `outputs/`.

### Pre-release check

- [ ] The purpose and minimum necessary dataset are clear.
- [ ] Ethics and governance requirements have been checked.
- [ ] Storage and named access arrangements are acceptable.
- [ ] Disclosure risk has been considered.
- [ ] Both parties have completed the agreement.
- [ ] The authorised BNR role has approved the release.
- [ ] The agreement and release have been recorded internally.

:::

## Submit the agreement

Save the completed page as a PDF, then attach it to an email using the button below. The button opens a pre-addressed draft; it does not send the form or attach the PDF automatically.

[Prepare email to BNR](mailto:bnr@uwi.edu?subject=BNR%20Research%20Data%20Sharing%20Agreement){.btn .btn-primary}
